ctx.x: MR. HENDERSON: -- like Kenny Sargent, and Sonny Dunham played trombone and trumpet. Oh, those were great guys, man. And Peewee Hunt and that -- in that era. Okay. Those guys would play, man, and open up. They would generally be the first band to start. They would open up, and they would play like mad, you know what I mean, and swinging the whole crowd, four or 5,000 people there. Okay.
Now Fletcher had -- I think I told you this before -- had a book, had two sets of books. He had one for arrangements.
